---
name: debugging
description: Use when diagnosing bugs, crashes, failed tests or unexpected behavior.
---

# Debugging

Use a root-cause-first process.

1. Reproduce the issue.
2. Establish expected behavior.
3. Trace execution.
4. Inspect logs and errors.
5. Identify the first incorrect state.
6. Form a hypothesis.
7. Test the hypothesis.
8. Fix the root cause.
9. Add a regression test.
10. Verify the fix.
